command:
sudo mkdir -p /etc/inventory /usr/local/sbin
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Pulls /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) and applies it
# to the local copy on node2 only if content differs. Idempotent, safe to
# run frequently from cron.
set -e
SRC_HOST=node1
DEST=/etc/inventory/app.conf
TMP=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)

cleanup() { rm -f "$TMP"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

if ! ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 antrieb@"$SRC_HOST" 'sudo -n cat /etc/inventory/app.conf' > "$TMP" 2>/tmp/sync-inventory-conf.err; then
    logger -t sync-inventory-conf "ERROR: failed to fetch app.conf from $SRC_HOST: $(cat /tmp/sync-inventory-conf.err)"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$TMP" ]; then
    logger -t sync-inventory-conf "ERROR: fetched app.conf from $SRC_HOST was empty, refusing to apply"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$DEST" ] || ! cmp -s "$TMP" "$DEST"; then
    chmod 644 "$TMP"
    mv "$TMP" "$DEST"
    logger -t sync-inventory-conf "updated $DEST from $SRC_HOST"
else
    rm -f "$TMP"
fi
EOF
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
